verdict.rationale: Gecko runs security work in the background once set up. PR scans post pass/fail checks automatically with configurable fail-on severity, and Gecko can commit fixes directly to a PR's head branch. It rechecks findings after merge to mark them Fix verified, and its API lets users manage scan schedules and receive webhook events that can kick off downstream workflows. missing for 10: detailed documentation of scheduled-scan configuration (it appears only as a one-line API mention), a general user-defined automation/rule builder beyond scans and webhooks, independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations work as described.
